start_with: Identify the target platform.
Confirm the installed Rock version: Apple TV requires Rock 14 or later; Roku requires Rock 16.7 or later.
Confirm that the expected TV application administration blocks and site types exist in the installed package.
Confirm the operator has permission to view and administer the relevant CMS configuration pages.
For Roku development, verify whether the current Core-team development-application process is required and has been completed.
Stop page-level debugging until the application record can be opened. Apple TV Docs Roku Docs
branches.title: The TV application administration feature is missing
branches.when: The TV application administration feature is missing

start_with: Confirm that the page belongs to the intended TV application.
Render the Lava and inspect the final output, not just the template source.
For Apple TV, validate the result as TVML.
For Roku, validate it as SceneGraph XML and confirm `Rock:Page` is the outermost component.
Check for missing or malformed data emitted through Lava.
Inspect page cache settings to rule out an older response.
Test the page in the target shell; browser rendering is not equivalent to TVML or SceneGraph rendering. Apple TV Pages
branches.title: A page is blank, rejected, or never appears
branches.when: A page is blank, rejected, or never appears

do_not_assume: Do not assume the Roku shell creates menus automatically from the setting.
start_with: Confirm that the page setting is enabled.
Inspect the Lava that constructs the menu.
Confirm that the page collection and Show in Menu value are actually read by that Lava.
Confirm that the resulting SceneGraph contains an actionable menu item.
Do not assume the Roku shell creates menus automatically from the setting.
branches.title: A Roku page marked “Show in Menu” is absent
branches.when: A Roku page marked “Show in Menu” is absent

start_with: Confirm the rendered page has an outer `Rock:Page`.
Check that `initialFocus` exactly matches a rendered control ID.
Confirm the target control is present and focusable.
For a horizontal or vertical group, verify the `FocusGroup` orientation.
For a `RowList`, verify the required root, row, and item `ContentNode` hierarchy.
Reduce the page to a simple layout before introducing additional SceneGraph or custom BrightScript components. Rock Page Control Roku Focus Group
branches.title: Roku focus does not move or starts on the wrong item
branches.when: Roku focus does not move or starts on the wrong item

start_with: Confirm that the element is a control documented to support `rockCommand`.
Check the exact command name.
Check every required command-specific parameter.
For navigation, verify the destination page belongs to the application and that any query parameters are valid.
For chained Roku commands, verify comma separation and validate each command independently before recombining them.
Inspect whether stale cached markup still contains an older command.
Test in the actual shell version because a valid attribute in documentation does not prove support in an older client. Roku Commands Rock Button
branches.title: A command does nothing

start_with: Confirm the application record points to the intended external website Authentication Page.
Confirm that page contains the Remote Authentication block.
Confirm the block is associated with the correct TV application site.
Confirm the person can reach the website route.
For Apple TV, verify the login page contains the single-brace `{ authQrCodeUrl }` and `{ authCode }` placeholders.
For Roku, verify the page contains controls with IDs `lgnQrPoster` and `lgnCodeLabel`.
Confirm the login command targets the correct login, timeout, and success TV pages. Creating an Apple TV Sign-in Page
branches.title: Remote sign-in shows no QR code or code
branches.when: Remote sign-in shows no QR code or code

start_with: Confirm the website user is authenticated.
Confirm the code belongs to the currently displayed device session.
Retry with a newly generated code to eliminate expiration.
Confirm the website Remote Authentication block is associated with the same TV application site.
Check the configured expiration and throttling settings in the installed block.
Inspect server logs or the block’s returned error without exposing codes or session records.

Stop before modifying authentication records directly. At the supplied source commit, verification depends on an active session, matching code timing, and the device unique identifier. RemoteAuthentication.cs at commit 471fd303
branches.title: A remote-authentication code is rejected

do_not_assume: Do not use a YouTube page URL.
start_with: Confirm the command is attached to a supported actionable control.
Confirm that video uses a direct MP4 or HLS resource, or that audio uses a direct MP3 resource.
Do not use a YouTube page URL.
Confirm the TV device can reach the media URL.
Remove optional Media Element, interaction, watch-map, artwork, and related-entity parameters and test direct playback.
Add metadata and tracking parameters back one group at a time.
For live Roku video, verify the live-stream parameter and source behavior. Apple TV Media Commands
branches.title: Media does not start

start_with: Confirm whether the intended outcome is resume-only or appending to an existing interaction.
For resume-only, inspect the supplied watch map.
To append, supply both the existing interaction identifier and its watch map.
If only the watch map is supplied, expect the documented behavior to use its position while creating a new interaction.
Confirm that the correct Rock Media Element identifier is supplied when Rock-managed watch tracking is expected. Apple TV Media Commands
branches.title: Playback starts at the wrong position or creates a new interaction
branches.when: Playback starts at the wrong position or creates a new interaction

do_not_assume: Do not use Public caching for personalized output without a reviewed isolation design.
start_with: Determine whether the rendered output varies by person, context, query parameter, or authentication state.
Inspect the page’s cacheability type, Max Age, and Max Shared Age where applicable.
Inspect command-level cache control on Roku navigation.
Do not use Public caching for personalized output without a reviewed isolation design.
Clear or bypass the relevant cache in a controlled test.
Re-render with two distinct test contexts and confirm they cannot receive each other’s output. Roku Pages Roku Navigation Commands
branches.title: A page shows stale or another context’s content
branches.when: A page shows stale or another context’s content

entrypoint: Choose the branch whose symptom matches the user's task, then inspect the live records before making changes.
